name: Vidmoat
description: Edits video programmatically from agents over a remote MCP server and a REST v1 API: import media, run timeline commands, preview frames, transcribe and render MP4s. OAuth or Bearer key required.

skills.name: Project Commands
skills.description: Applies and validates timeline edit commands against a project document via POST /projects/{id}/commands and /projects/{id}/validate, using the schema at /schema/commands.

skills.name: Render and Preview
skills.description: Queues MP4 renders via POST /renders, polls job progress at /renders/{id}, and fetches still preview frames from /projects/{id}/preview.

skills.name: Media Library
skills.description: Uploads files, imports media from a URL and searches the stock library through /media/uploads, /media/import and /stock/search.

skills.name: Transcription
skills.description: Transcribes uploaded audio and video via POST /ai/transcriptions, returning a job polled at /ai/jobs/{id}.

skills.name: Speech Generation
skills.description: Creates and manages personal voice profiles under /speech/voices and generates narration at /speech/generations, with audio downloads per generation.

skills.name: Generative Media
skills.description: Generates images, stickers, video and animated stills via /ai/images, /ai/stickers, /ai/videos and /ai/live-images.

skills.name: Editing Agent
skills.description: Runs Vidmoat's own editing agent over a project via POST /ai/agent, which applies edit commands to the timeline on the caller's behalf.
